chapter: Sam Morgan, repertoire and Silver Leaf
title: Sam Dutrey Sr., Arthur Williams and Camilla Todd
summary: Sam Dutrey Sr. played with LaCaze often; Arthur Williams was a clarinetist; Camilla Todd a pianist he worked with.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: And what about Sam Dutry Sr.?

Sam Dutry Sr., he played with me quite a bit. You know, we was practically in the same age group. And we were pretty good friends. And he played with me quite a bit. He never was a member of the band. He played with us quite a bit.
I think Harrison Bonds told me about him.
I think Harrison Bonds told me about the old man dude. Yeah. The one I knew was quite young.
Yeah, yeah, the one you knew was quite young. And he died. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
The young Sam just died on the job.
Yeah, that's right. Yeah, but the other one's been dead quite a while. Oh yeah, yeah.
And Lord's been dead a while.
Lord's been dead a while too, yeah.
And you say you don't remember about Arthur Williams, who he played with.

Arthur Williams? No, I'll tell you the truth. I can't remember if he played with anybody regularly, but I know he played with me in different bands, you know. We played together in different bands. What instrument did he play with? He was a clarinet player, Arthur Williams. No, not as I knew of. And Camilla Todd?
Did you know her? Yeah, I knew her well. I mean, you know, we worked together quite a little while.
